Definition: to tread upon (as a potter, in walking or abusively)
BiblicalUsage: Ramas means to tread upon, to trample underfoot. Isaiah says, 'The foot shall tread it down, even the feet of the poor, and the steps of the needy'; Daniel saw the he-goat smite the ram and cast him to the ground and stamp upon him; and Micah says the remnant of Jacob shall be among the nations 'as a lion among the beasts of the forest... who, if he go through, both treadeth down, and teareth in pieces.'
TheologicalSignificance: I am convinced that treading down is judgment's image: the poor shall tread the lofty city, the goat shall stamp the ram — and the God who lifts up also lays low.
